status: SURVEY_ONLY / NOT A WORLD LAW / P,T,C of Gate V0 unchanged

candidates.U: Accumulating carry (designer). Per atom state (P integer coarse units, r exact rational residual); authoritative p = P + r. Each contribution delta: r += delta, then carry while r >= 1: P += 1, r -= 1; while r <= -1: P -= 1, r += 1 (|r| < 1).
candidates.L: Net ledger residual (reviewer). All contributions of the step are summed exactly per atom first; then p_new = P + r + net and normalize once: P = round_half_even(p_new), r = p_new - P (|r| <= 1/2).
candidates.U_Ponly: NEGATIVE CONTROL: U whose drift reads P only. Must FAIL T11; exists only to prove the test can detect the defect.
candidates.reference: Exact rational: p = p0 + sum of all contributions, x = x0 + sum of exact displacements.
candidates.P_T_C: Gate V0 laws, imported read-only for comparison (multiparticle_rounding_v0.laws).

contributions: Closed pair (i, j, delta): j += delta and i -= delta with the SAME exact delta. External (i, delta, name): i += delta and the external momentum ledger[name] -= delta. No wall/contact/friction law is implemented; external entries are synthetic ledger inputs only.

drift.units: synthetic: momentum coarse unit 1, position grid unit 1, displacement = p * c with c = dt/m in position units per momentum unit
drift.grid_mode: C1-B1 v2 meaning: x += round_half_even(p * c), p = P + r (U_Ponly uses P)
drift.exact_mode: x += p * c exactly (exact rational position)

c_values.realistic_C1B1: 2^-80 * 40 / m(Ar40 in m_e) / 2^-48 (momentum unit 2^-80 a.u., position unit 2^-48 bohr)

tests.T1: +0.4 +0.4 +0.4 onto one atom (closed pairs from three partners): net +1.2 must survive
tests.T2: +0.4 -0.4 onto one atom: net 0, residual must be exactly 0 after normalization
tests.T6: three bodies B, A, W: B pushes A (A +0.6, B -0.6), A transfers to W (A -0.6, W +0.6); W also as external ledger variant. A net 0, momentum moves B -> W, total conserved (external ledger included)
tests.T7: Gate V0 counterexamples: 0.1 x K (K = 1..20), 0.4 x 3, (-0.8, 0.4, 0.4), and far-Ar rational stand-in (pair impulse enclosure midpoints at 512 bits from the V0 far-field geometry, labelled as rational stand-ins)
tests.T8: order: forward, reverse, all permutations of the entry list when <= 8 entries (else 24 deterministic rotations/reversals), and 3 groupings for L
tests.T9: atom relabelling: all permutations for N <= 4
tests.T10: U vs L: authoritative p and drift results compared; representation (P, r) compared separately
tests.T11: drift: P = 1, r = 0.2 at c = 1/2 -> P*c rounds to 0 but p*c rounds to 1 (grid mode); exact mode equals reference; U_Ponly must FAIL
tests.T12: N = 3, 10,000 steps, deterministic pair impulses A01 = ((7k mod 11) - 5)/10, A02 = ((5k mod 13) - 6)/20, A12 = ((3k mod 7) - 3)/3, initial p = (1/3, -1/7, -4/21); drift c = 1/3 in both modes. Adversarial denominator sequence: 2,000 steps of A01 = (-1)^k/(k+2).
tests.T13: exhaustive N=3 (A in k/10, k=-15..15) and N=4 (A in k/5, k=-4..4) as Gate V0; compared with the stored V0 P/T/C statistics
tests.T14: state: values per atom; residual numerator/denominator bit lengths; runtime of U, L, P, T, C on the same N=4 exhaustive inputs
tests.R_realization: Physical (Lang 2024, frozen C1-B1 evaluator) impulses are transcendental; RULES section 1 requires recorded values to be exact rationals decided from enclosures. So a residual must live on a finite grid 2^-(80+k). For k in {8, 16, 32}: R_k = pair impulses rounded once on FX(96+k, 80+k) (c1b1 impulse with the finer profile), accumulated exactly as P + r. Check that R_k equals P on the finer grid bit for bit, and measure the far-field center collective loss (V0 geometry) in coarse units.

core_conditions: C1 collective: T1, T7 net survive exactly in p
C2 conservation: sum of p (+ external ledger) exactly 0 change in every test
C5 drift reads P + r (T11) and exact mode equals reference
C6 no STOP / no arbitrary atom choice
C7 state O(N): per-atom (P, r) only, no per-pair hidden state
C8 no systematic momentum bias in T12 (p equals exact reference)
C9 bounded residual for bounded-denominator impulse streams (T12 main); growth reported for the adversarial stream
equivalence_rule: If U and L give identical p and identical drift results in every test: SAME_SEMANTICS_DIFFERENT_NORMALIZATION (report one example where (P, r) differ). Otherwise report the smallest counterexample.
verdict_rule: 1. If any core condition fails for U/L (not counting the negative control): C for C1/C2 failures, D for C5/C8 failures, E for C7/C9 failures.

2. Else if R_realization shows that the only RULES-compatible realization for physical impulses equals P on a finer grid and the far-field collective loss is nonzero for every tested k: B (U = L equivalent; exact form verified on rational inputs; physical realization moves the P trade-off to a finer grid, cost/precision choice unresolved).
3. Else if R_realization keeps the far-field collective effect with bounded state: A.
no_post_hoc_changes: Tests, thresholds and the verdict rule are fixed before running.
